facts.business: Revathi Equipment India Limited manufactures blast hole drills, exploratory drills, and water well drills for construction and mining applications, and provides spares and after-sales services.
key_risks: Volatile geopolitical environment causing customers to defer capital expenditure and order intake
Lower volume reducing absorption of fixed manufacturing and operating overheads
facts.related_party_note: The Company has granted loans to other entities (aggregate amount during the year INR 5 Cr, balance outstanding INR 4 Cr) and provided guarantees on behalf of parties other than subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates (aggregate amount during the year INR 94 Cr, balance outstanding INR 94 Cr).
